claims.statement: Authenticated control-plane readers receive typed camel-case aggregate, template, capability, policy, and instance list/detail projections with all resolved catalog records, full detail schemas, exact stable IDs, and no system-prompt text or compiler file references.

The ordered department-to-function-to-instance hierarchy derives all counts and relationships from the resolved source: 5 departments, 12 functions, 36 templates, 43 instances, department totals 12/6/5/14/6, and exactly two source-ordinal deployments for each of seven Community templates.

Every static representation is serialized once into sealed immutable canonical bytes, receives a representation-specific strong ETag over the exact bytes served, honors strong or weak If-None-Match validators with 304, and cannot drift if nested source data changes after projection.

All catalog reads authorize a server-issued human viewer-equivalent role before loading, reject service or unrelated principals, compile and project offline in one bounded single-flight worker, cache only a complete immutable result, and return a sanitized no-store 503 for unavailable, malformed, mismatched, synchronous, or timed-out query dependencies.

limitations: API-02 projects the compiled version-controlled catalog and its seed deployment defaults. API-03 and DEL-04 still own persisted effective instance configuration, database/source parity, optimistic revisions, transactional seeding, and mutation; the successful static projection is not described as live database state.

The deployment-only configuration-schema route and PATCH remain API-03 scope. The instance status summary and recent-run enrichment remain API-07 scope and must use a separate runtime watermark; the future fixed status route must be registered before the dynamic instance-detail route.

Capability display labels are deterministic neutral API labels derived from stable capability IDs because the v1 source capability model has no explicit display-name field. A later catalog format may make those labels authoritative source data.

The first successful complete source projection is cached for the life of the API process. Version-controlled catalog deployment therefore requires a process restart; API-03 must add explicit invalidation/versioning before mutable persisted configuration participates in these representations.

Static list routes return the entire bounded v1 inventory rather than server-side filters or pagination. Browser search/filter behavior remains WEB-02 scope, while a later API version may add query filters without changing these complete snapshots.

API-09 still owns the unified application/problem+json error vocabulary and global retry/timeout policy. DEL-07 still owns a committed OpenAPI snapshot and generated client drift gate; API-02 verifies the live typed OpenAPI declarations only.
